tasks.notes: Last check est. ~120k; spec interval 40k, now 170k. FSM procedure: FSM/1pz-1hz-1hdt-adjustment-of-valve-clearance.pdf (EM-19–22). Cold engine, intake pipe + valve cover off, No.1 TDC (pulley groove to timing cover groove, cyl 1 lifters loose / cyl 6 tight). Position 1: IN 1,2,4 + EX 1,3,5. Turn crank 360° clockwise only. Position 2: IN 3,5,6 + EX 2,4,6. Spec cold: IN 0.15–0.25 mm, EX 0.35–0.45 mm. Record all 12. New shim: IN N = T + (A − 0.20), EX N = T + (A − 0.40); measure T with a micrometer. One session: RADD will take back unused shims, so order one of each of the 20 sizes (~$250 float), measure, swap, recheck, and return the leftovers in their packets with the invoice on the way back through Kamloops. Glow plugs stay in. Guards against a tight exhaust valve burning.

tasks.task: Cold Belt Squeal Above ~2k RPM — Find the Belt, Fit the Gates Kit
tasks.notes: Sept 2026 test: in neutral, stationary or moving, any gear — squeal comes on at ~2–3k rpm, silent at idle, gone once warm. Threshold-at-rpm behaviour = a belt slipping under accessory load, not a bearing (bearings whine from idle up). Which belt, while it squeals at 2.5k: turn the wheel toward lock = power steering belt (cold thick ATF, most common); AC/defrost off→on = AC belt (over-charge adds drag); headlights + high beams + blower full = alternator belt. Water splash on the guilty belt silences it briefly. Check tension by deflection and look for glazed shiny sidewalls. Simplest end: fit all three belts from the Gates kit and set tension.

tasks.task: Engine Rebuild — 1HD-T (Eli) — Only If Symptoms Worsen
tasks.notes: Reference (Sept 2026): RADD stocks the Engine Australia 1HD-T rebuild kit EKTO350A at C$2,295.98 (pistons, rings, bearings, gaskets — confirm sizes with them before ordering); machining, head work and labour are on top. Sept 2026 status: engine running well — lots of power, burning very little oil, not running hot. Smokes on cold start until warm, then clean. Some blowby present. Decision: no rebuild until symptoms increase (oil use up, smoke persisting warm, blowby worsening, power loss). One worn ring confirmed earlier; diagnosis stands. Full long block rebuild with Eli when the time comes: head, block, crank, rods, pistons, bearings, cam. Est. ~$11,500 all-in. Rebuild scope also covers: valve clearance check (1HD-T cold spec inlet 0.20 mm, exhaust 0.35 mm — Jon Fox suggested checking before the pump work); glow plug circuit + plugs (dash light does not illuminate, truck starts in 1 crank so low priority — flag with Steve at EBI first, Eli may be less familiar with LC80 ancillaries); vacuum system assessment + rebuild (pump, hoses, check valves — same reason). Also fit the new clutch slave cylinder (HD Auto, on hand) while the driveline is apart. Compression test: deferred — glow plugs stay in until the rebuild, so test when the injectors come out for Jon Fox or at teardown (diesel gauge, all six warm, fuel cut solenoid unplugged; look for spread >10% to find the worn-ring cylinder).

Job: drop the sump, one rod cap at a time, fit new ACL Race shells + new rod bolts, lay Plastigauge across each crank journal to confirm clearance is in spec. In-car, no engine pull. Liam, 3 hrs @ $85 = ~$255 labour; parts ~$359 (RADD: ACL Race STD shells $190, 12 rod bolts $144, FIPG ~$25). ~$615 all-in. Do before running hard on the tuned pump. See 2026 Strategy for part links.
